description:
City and county agenda items that pause or ban new data centers (moratoria), newest first, with the place, the meeting date, the agenda record link and the true total. Default window: the last 30 days.

Example questions:
- "Which counties have paused data centers?"
- "Any data-center moratorium votes in Georgia?"

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX, VA, OH.

name: data_center_moratoriums
title: Data Center Moratoriums
